row: Soft Landing Animal Sanctuary is a Non Profit retreat in the foothills of Tennessee.  We rescue abandoned, injured, and unwanted farm animals.  Animals that would have faced horrific and tragically short futures.  Through Care and Compassion, our team has helped hundreds of tired souls.
